selection_rule: Process all 48 identities in frozen pool_order without early exit; an identity is eligible only when the earliest run contains 300 intrinsics stems whose pose is covered, whose orientation index is 1 or 3, and whose adjacent timestamps satisfy 0 < gap <= 0.5 seconds. Non-portrait frames, pose rejects, non-positive gaps and gaps above 0.5 seconds break the run. After all 48 identities are processed, lock exactly the first 32 eligible identities in pool_order. If fewer than 32 qualify, publish no Phase-A selection lock and assign no role.

integrity_contract.trajectory: Every non-empty row has exactly seven finite fields; at least two rows; timestamps strictly increase.
integrity_contract.intrinsics_archive: All members pass ZIP CRC and path-safety checks; every .pincam member has a unique stem and is parsed, including members outside selected windows.
integrity_contract.intrinsics_payload: Exactly six finite fields width height fx fy cx cy; width and height are positive integers; fx and fy are positive; the principal point is within image bounds.
integrity_contract.continuity: Official stored world-to-camera angle-axis plus translation is inverted to camera-to-world, bracketed poses use SLERP, and any pose reject breaks the portrait run.

attempt_and_resume_contract.attempt_receipt: A fresh output root is created with exact protocol, roster, HEAD, source-scope, activation, producer and identity-plan bindings before GET.
attempt_and_resume_contract.checkpoint_seal: exclusive JSON plus byte-count and SHA-256 sidecar
attempt_and_resume_contract.resume: An existing root requires --resume, a byte-equivalent attempt receipt, no final manifest, no temporary-download directory, and valid checkpoint seals plus retained-file SHA verification.
attempt_and_resume_contract.noncheckpoint_crash: If retained source files were published before their checkpoint, preserve the failed evidence root and rerun in a fresh versioned root.

retention_contract.purpose: Allow the independent offline validator to reparse all 96 bodies and recompute eligibility and the first-32 lock.

forbidden: request or read lowres_wide.zip, lowres_depth.zip, confidence.zip or any other asset
read RGB, depth, confidence, source-derived task truth, model output or D1/D2/R2 outcome
stop after 32 eligible identities without processing the full frozen pool
bridge a portrait run across non-portrait, pose-rejected, duplicate-time or over-gap frames
enter Phase-B without a later explicit activation
describe Phase-A selection as accuracy, performance, production, Android-default or safety evidence
authority: Exact-48 intrinsics/trajectory source integrity and label-blind portrait/pose continuity only. A PASS locks 32 Phase-A identities but assigns no TRAIN or DEVELOPMENT role and gives no Phase-B, truth, model, R2, performance, production or safety authority.
